company.name: Lygos - Better Materials for Better Products
company.shortDescription: Lygos is a Specialty Chemical Company
company.description: Lygos, Inc. is a sustainable specialty chemical company accelerating the transition to high-performing, sustainable solutions. We create performance polymers tailored for diverse applications, from agronomy to home care and personal care. With an integrated supply chain, we ensure efficient, cost-effective delivery at commercial scale, enabling brands to meet their performance and sustainability goals. By replacing persistent chemicals with superior alternatives, Lygos is driving measurable environmental and operational impact.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $1,790,000, or 0.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 15 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 4 disclosed grants total $6,540,000, representing 3.07% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $20,155,590 to $77,408,228, a 3.84x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
